gloss: acting on behalf of, proxy service

definitions.gloss: acting on behalf of, performing duties as a substitute
definitions.explanation: Carrying out tasks or responsibilities in place of someone else. Used for both formal delegation and commercial proxy services.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}の{代行|だいこう}を{務|つと}める。
examples.english: To serve as a substitute for the department head.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう}サービスを{利用|りよう}した。
examples.english: I used a designated driver service.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}が{不在|ふざい}の{間|あいだ}、{副社長|ふくしゃちょう}が{業務|ぎょうむ}を{代行|だいこう}している。
examples.english: While the president is away, the vice president is handling the duties on his behalf.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代行|だいこう}する (to act on behalf of)
- {代行|だいこう}{者|しゃ} (proxy, substitute person)
- {代行|だいこう}サービス (proxy service)
- {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう} (designated driver service)
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{代行|だいこう} (business proxy, outsourcing)

CULTURAL NOTE: {運転|うんてん}{代行|だいこう} is a popular service in Japan where a professional driver takes you and your car home when you've been drinking. It is widely available near entertainment districts.
